# archestra_mcp_catalog_label_keys (Data Source)

Distinct label keys across all MCP registry catalog items. Useful for validating label-based catalog-item references before applying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Distinct label keys in the MCP registry catalog. Useful for asserting
# a label-based catalog item reference matches at least one item.
data "archestra_mcp_catalog_label_keys" "all" {}

output "catalog_label_keys" {
  value = data.archestra_mcp_catalog_label_keys.all.keys
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (List of String) Distinct label keys present on at least one catalog item.
